title: (RHEA-2017:0418) new package: ostree
portal_summary: A new ostree package is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

* This enhancement update adds the ostree package to Red Hat Enterprise Linux Extras, intended for use via the "atomic" command's system containers implementations. (BZ#1420163)

All users who require ostree are advised to install this new package.
